Lower feature distance is better. Primary HR-VITON uses the shared mask; native-mask sensitivity is tabulated separately.
Scorer: full-image 224×224 DINO + learned regional experts. Not validated as tiny-detail accuracy. Buttons n=8; pockets n=3.
